dimensions.assessment: Affects all household appliance manufacturers, retailers, and consumers purchasing designated appliances.
dimensions.evidence: manufacturer of a household appliance ... sold or offered for sale at retail to a consumer

dimensions.assessment: Mandates new labeling, web disclosures, consumer reporting mechanisms, and NIST standard-setting for household appliances.
dimensions.evidence: disclose on a conspicuous label or tag affixed to each such appliance ... estimated performance life

dimensions.assessment: Imposes administrative and compliance responsibilities on NIST and the FTC, though specific federal budget figures are omitted.
dimensions.evidence: Director shall promulgate regulations ... FTC shall enforce subsection (a)

dimensions.assessment: Requires NIST to designate appliances and operating conditions, and tasks the FTC with enforcing requirements as unfair or deceptive acts.
dimensions.evidence: A violation of subsection (a) ... shall be treated as a violation of a regulation under section 18(a)(1)(B) of the Federal Trade Commission Act

dimensions.assessment: Permanent regulatory and labeling requirement for covered household appliances.

missing_information: Specific list of household appliances to be designated by NIST
Exact cost of compliance for manufacturers
importance_detail.rationale: Requires household appliance manufacturers to disclose estimated performance life, maintenance costs, and software update timelines on labels and websites, enforced by the FTC.
